name: Pul
overview: The name Pul appears in Scripture primarily as the king of Assyria who exerted influence over Israel by compelling King Menahem to pay a substantial tribute, securing his reign (2 Kings 15:19). God is also described as stirring the spirit of Pul to carry away several Israelite tribes into exile, demonstrating divine sovereignty over Assyrian actions (1 Chronicles 5:26). Additionally, Pul is mentioned as a distant nation or region to which God's people would be sent to proclaim His glory, highlighting the broad reach of God's redemptive plan beyond Israel (Isaiah 66:19).
